children.value: > Fact From Story: Xavier Watts was a wrecking ball against Williams and the USC offense, picking off Williams twice, forcing a fumble and taking another fumble in for a score.
> > Fact From Story: Watts recovered a fumble after a reception by Mario Williams and raced it into the end zone.

> > > Fact From Story: Williams finished the contest with arguably the worst game of his career as No. 21 Notre Dame rode the crucial turnovers and a relentless pass-rush to an overwhelming 48-20 win at home against No. 10 USC.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Defeating a team is better than losing to them.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: An interception and forced fumble are defensive plays that prevent the opposing team from scoring.
> Commonsense Knowledge: A player who gets two interceptions, forces a fumble and scores a touchdown has a great performance.
